summary: Injured skier with possible head injury on Quandary Peak; 911 call ~10:30 a.m. A Flight for Life helicopter diverted en route to Colorado Springs and airlifted the skier to a Denver hospital.
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group, Flight for Life
notes: SCRG spokesperson Anna DeBattiste; source is a 2023-04-27 Alpine Institute roundup quoting Summit Daily. Incident date Sunday 2023-04-23 weekday-verified.
